A.title: Large Language Models are Fixated by Red Herrings: Exploring Creative Problem Solving and Einstellung Effect using the Only Connect Wall Dataset

E.headline: GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 fall far below human quiz-show performance on grouping and connections; fewer red herrings raise LLM performance, consistent with fixation.

G.notes: Red-herring effect is shown only as accuracy gain on OCW-Randomized and OCW-WordNet (Table 5, no test, no human data), so coded as accuracy rows. Human data are TV contestants, not an experiment. LLM sensitivity to clue order not tested (Sec. 6). Query date missing for snapshots. Embedding baselines not listed as models.
